images.prompt:
Create one original photorealistic field-guide portrait of an anonymous mature Lupo Italiano. Independently written factual morphology only; no photograph input or named animal.

Mature female about62cm within58–65cm, strong dry balanced slightly rectangular body, robust not overly long trunk, deep chest, straight level back and croup not lowered. Clean strong head with moderate tapered muzzle slightly shorter than skull, black nose/lips/rims, medium oblique golden eyes, medium mobile natural parallel erect ears. Strong dry straight legs with moderate hind angulation and oval paws. Medium-length medium-hard flat/slightly wavy trunk/thigh doublecoat, short head/legs and distinct modest neck ruff. Gray-sable with subdued fawn/beige ground, dark saddle, lighter underside/legs and dark muzzle/tail tip. Rather long well-furnished natural tail without exaggeration, low hanging relaxed, complete attachment/course/tapered endpoint, no upright axis, tight curl or over-back loop.

New composition: quiet standing left-facing three-quarter adult, head slightly turned toward viewer and mouth closed, on a broad clear Italian mountain footpath above a beech wood. Rocky ridge in distant soft focus and restrained rust/gold foliage, cool clear late-autumn daylight. Moderate natural coat and functional adult proportions. Show four coherent complete limb courses and four grounded oval paws with believable joints, body weight and contact shadows. Use a low relaxed attached tail, slightly separated from rear legs, with its whole course and free endpoint distinct and safely inside frame; never copy the source raised tight C-curl. No copied individual markings, pose, expression, lighting or photograph framing.

Landscape1536×1024 at dog-eye level, one dog only. Frame whole head, ears, trunk, all four paws and complete natural tail with generous crop-safe margins, at least100px beyond ears, paws and tail. Uncluttered dry ground reveals every paw; no foliage or rocks crossing legs. No people, collar, leash, gear, fencing, snow rescue staging, animals, logos, text or watermark. Natural photorealistic anatomy and coat texture, no puppy exaggeration or wolf substitution.

profileEvidence.summary: Lively, proud and independent, the Lupo Italiano tends to form close bonds with its people while remaining reserved with strangers. Its association describes a versatile search dog that follows ground trails and scent carried on the air, including in mountain rescue. Mario Messi began developing the population in 1966.
